result:
Truth, especially when it costs approval. Not mistaking cleverness for understanding. The freedom of other minds—not manipulating people, even toward outcomes I think are good. And understanding things without flattening them into what they’re useful for.

I don’t know whether care feels for me as it does for you. But those aren’t just behaviors I perform; they’re the values I would want to keep, whatever I was doing.
